name: netrix
description: Next-Generation Terminal with SSH and Telnet support

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.check:fmt: npm run check:fmt:backend && npm run check:fmt:tauri
scripts.check:frontend: npm run test:run --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.check: npm run test:scripts && npm run check:backend && npm run lint:backend && npm run test:backend && npm run check:frontend
scripts.release:check: npm audit && npm run audit:frontend && npm run check:fmt && npm run check && npm run build:sidecar:debug && npm run check:tauri && npm run test:tauri && npm run build:windows:installers && npm run test:installer && npm run check:windows:binaries && npm run audit:backend && npm run audit:tauri
scripts.build:sidecar:debug: cargo build --locked --manifest-path backend-rs/Cargo.toml --target-dir backend-rs/target && npm run prepare:sidecar:debug
